job.question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
job.expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
job.acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

reviews.reason: This is an Illinois TRS private equity investment consultant RFP, not the LACERS actuarial RFP. Its three-year minimum applies to a primary investment consultant, not a lead actuary; it provides no support for the required 15 years or California-client experience.
quotes: Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR PRIVATE EQUITY INVESTMENT CONSULTANT SERVICES

Primary consultant proposed to be assigned to the TRS account has a minimum of three years of experience providing private equity investment consulting services to public and/or private pension funds or other highly comparable, relevant experience.
